reason: My bookkeeper already runs everything through Zoho Expense and it works well enough. I'd have to rip out a working setup and get her to trust a Telegram bot, and I won't do that just because it sounds neat.
objection: I don't believe the duplicate catching until I see it. If it misses one re-photographed transfer screenshot, I'm paying for a receipt-to-table bot I still have to double-check, on top of the app I already have.
would_change_my_mind: Running my old group chat archive through the free tier and seeing it catch real duplicates my current setup missed, plus a clean export into Zoho so it adds to my stack instead of replacing it.
